SASINI LIMITED AND SUBSIDIARIES
ANNUAL REPORT AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 SEPTEMBER 2010

REPORT OF THE DIRECTORS
FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 SEPTEMBER 2010
The Directors have pleasure in presenting their report and the audited financial statements for the year ended 30
September 2010 which show the state of affairs of the Group and the Company.
ACTIVITIES
The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are the growing and processing of tea and coffee,
commercial milling and marketing of coffee, value addition of related products, forestry, dairy operations, livestock
and horticulture.
